- api: swagger ImageManifestSummary.ImageData: fix invalid required field. [moby/moby#53750](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53750)
- api: update go-swagger to v0.36.6. [moby/moby#53754](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53754)
